resources.string: Minecraft Appearance
PROFILE LOOK
Choose how Minecraft looks for this profile. The game itself is untouched: the custom look is a small resource pack the launcher builds for the exact game version and enables before each launch.
Switching back to Vanilla removes the launcher pack from the active list and restores your previous settings. Your own packs, worlds and mods are never touched.
Vanilla Experience
Original Minecraft main menu and loading screen, exactly as Mojang ships them.
CS Custom Experience
Dark obsidian menu with platinum accents: Craft Studio title, night panorama, restyled buttons, custom splashes and a dark loading screen.
Minecraft 1.21 and newer (built for the profile\'s version at launch)
